svg.aria-label: Basic Sign In, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. A Basic request passes the Host gate, the limiter and a cache of 300 s before a realm sees the password. 1: Client to Host gate: GET /repository/<name>/<path>, Authorization: Basic. 2: Host gate to Limiter: Host names this server, else 403. 3: Limiter: reserve the pair; blocked, or 5 failures pending: 429 with Retry-After. 4: Limiter to Credential cache: name and password, keyed by HMAC. 5: Credential cache: hit: signed in, no realm asked. 6: Credential cache to Realms: miss: try the realms. 7: Realms to state.sqlite: local users: the stored hash. 8: Realms: then LDAP connections, then a user token as password. 9: Realms to Limiter: success: kept 300 s; failure: one more for the pair. 10: Host gate to Client: 200 with the file, 401 wrong pair, 403 no permission, 429.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry basic sign in
